title: Exact original Wilson conditional block to parallel product operator dictionary
verification_scope: Lean-certified exact finite-lattice identities. This module contains no assumed mixing estimate and asserts no physical mass gap.

parameters.group: Q = unitary (Quaternion Real), with existing proved SU(2) matrix equivalence.
parameters.period: n nonzero. These factorization identities use the actual independence condition and do not require n > 1 or even n.
parameters.coupling: Any real beta. Positivity and smallness of beta are not hypotheses of this exact dictionary.
parameters.block: S is a finite set of positive link coordinates with WilsonIndependentBlocks.Independent n S, meaning no plaquette is affected by two distinct selected links.
parameters.state: U : Link n -> Q is the actual retained full state.
parameters.action: stateAction n beta U = beta sum_p (2 - Re Tr U_p), using the actual toConfiguration coordinate map and unnormalized fundamental trace.

exact_construction.name: stateAction
exact_construction.formula: stateAction n beta : C(Link n -> Q, Real)
exact_construction.meaning: Continuous original full Wilson action through the actual Link-to-Edge configuration map.

exact_construction.name: overwrite
exact_construction.formula: overwrite n U S W i = if i in S then W i else U i
exact_construction.meaning: The selected coordinates are sampled, and all unselected original links are retained.

exact_construction.name: toConfiguration_overwrite
exact_construction.formula: toConfiguration(overwrite U S W) = blockUpdate(toConfiguration U) S W
exact_construction.meaning: Literal equality with the existing actual Wilson block update.

exact_construction.name: localAction_selected
exact_construction.formula: localAction(U,S,a,q) = -stateAction(U) + splitAction(exterior(U,a),q) for a in S
exact_construction.meaning: The factor supplied by the proved action decomposition differs from the full one-link conditional action by an explicit constant. This constant cancels in its normalized Gibbs law.

exact_construction.name: localAction_law
exact_construction.formula: law(Haar, localAction(U,S,a)) = if a in S then coordinateLaw(beta,U,a) else Haar
exact_construction.meaning: Each selected factor is the existing actual normalized Wilson conditional law. Every unselected auxiliary coordinate is unused by the action and remains Haar.

exact_construction.name: auxiliary_law_product
exact_construction.formula: law(Haar^Links, W -> stateAction(overwrite U S W)) = product_a (if a in S then coordinateLaw(beta,U,a) else Haar)
exact_construction.meaning: Equality of measures derived from the actual independent-block action decomposition and normalized factorization theorem.

exact_construction.name: overwrite_map_auxiliaryLaw
exact_construction.formula: map(overwrite U S, auxiliary law) = product_a (if a in S then coordinateLaw(beta,U,a) else dirac(U_a))
exact_construction.meaning: Exact map of a finite product measure. Selected coordinate maps are the identity; unselected coordinate maps are constant, so their Haar probabilities map to the retained Dirac masses.

exact_construction.name: integral_overwrite_eq_product
exact_construction.formula: Integral of F(overwrite U S W) under the actual auxiliary law equals integral of F under the selected-conditional/retained-Dirac product.
exact_construction.meaning: Obtained from the proved measure pushforward, for every real continuous observable F.

exact_construction.name: blockAverage_eq_parallelAverage
exact_construction.formula: CompactGibbsBlockUpdate.blockAverage Haar (stateAction n beta) S F U = ParallelOscillation.parallelAverage (fun a V -> coordinateLaw n beta V a) S F U
exact_construction.meaning: The generic actual conditional-expectation fiber identity is bound to the exact Wilson pushforward law. Binder order: n beta U S hS F.

scope.closed: The actual Wilson fixed-exterior conditional block operator is now the same literal product update used by the independently proved collective influence estimates.
scope.important_distinction: The product equality concerns a fixed-exterior conditional update on a geometrically independent selected block. It does not assert that the interacting full Wilson Gibbs measure is a product measure.
